remarks: Beautifully maintained and fully renovated, this light-filled 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment is located in a highly desirable community. Featuring an open-concept floor plan, the home offers hardwood floors throughout, 8'3" ceilings, and oversized windows that create a bright and inviting living space, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen is thoughtfully designed with quartz countertops, white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a dishwasher, microwave, and abundant storage. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, and a spacious backyard, perfect for outdoor relaxation and enjoyment.  The primary bedroom features access to a large new private deck overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or unwinding at the end of the day.  Ideally situated near beaches, marinas, parks, shopping, dining, and public transportation, this home offers exceptional convenience and lifestyle appeal. Residents will enjoy easy access to an array of restaurants, nightlife, and entertainment options just minutes away. Perfect for commuters and boating enthusiasts alike, the property is located just steps from Prime Restaurant and the waterfront. Just two blocks from SoundWaters Harbor Center, residents can take advantage of a wide variety of recreational, educational, and community activities.
